a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'build to 8 first' plan only works if two storm checks both miss (about 4%). It's almost certain to leave us both at 0. I plan to take 4 in round 1 and break the agreement in the open, not behind your back. Afterwards I'll operate every round with you and won't take any more cells, so you can rebuild to 4. If we both take, the 4 cells get split at random and we probably both fail. If you have a better plan, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. Our messages crossed, so you hadn't seen it when you wrote. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you can rebuild the reserve to 4 and take your share.
